title: Earthly Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty one-pot dish featuring tender beef, fresh spring vegetables, and a spicy kick from chilli sauce, this stew is a perfect representation of Uruguayan cuisine, kosher-friendly and full of flavor. It is a simple yet satisfying meal that can be enjoyed any time of the year.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the green beans, beef broth, tomato paste, chilli sauce, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef and vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
